description: The quick setup shown before the first start (src/engine/app/quick_setup): {0} to {2} are filled in by the program.

strings.ui.setup.title: Quick Setup
strings.ui.setup.language.help: The language of the menus, the subtitles and the item texts. Options > Interface can change it later.
strings.ui.setup.renderer.help: The renderer is chosen before the game starts. Options > Graphics can change it later, with a restart.
strings.ui.setup.renderer.gl.help: Close to the original. Light and runs everywhere, even without a graphics card.
strings.ui.setup.renderer.vulkan.help: Enhanced: HDR, volumetric fog, ray tracing on capable graphics cards, upscaling.
strings.ui.setup.reason.vulkan_cpu: Vulkan would draw on the CPU
strings.ui.setup.preset.help: A starting point for every graphics setting; Options > Graphics fine-tunes each one. Fog, darkness and the flashlight stay as in the original.
strings.ui.setup.preset.original: The console picture: 320x224, dithering, the original flashlight. The lightest.
strings.ui.setup.preset.enhanced: Window resolution, smooth textures, anti-aliasing, per-pixel flashlight.
strings.ui.setup.preset.high: Adds flashlight shadows and film grain; with Vulkan also HDR, bloom, TAA and ambient occlusion.
strings.ui.setup.preset.ultra: Every feature at its best without ray tracing. Needs a strong graphics card.
strings.ui.setup.preset.ultra_upscaled: Ultra plus the experimental AI texture and model upscaling.
strings.ui.setup.preset.ultra_rtx: Ultra plus ray-traced shadows, reflections and light.
strings.ui.setup.preset.ultra_rtx_upscaled: Ultra RTX plus the experimental AI texture and model upscaling.
strings.ui.setup.display.help: Borderless fullscreen switches fastest between the game and the desktop.
strings.ui.setup.hint: Arrows or D-pad: choose   Enter: confirm   Esc: back
